name: @livekit/portal
description: LiveKit Portal in the browser: teleoperate robots, run remote policies and record sessions

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p livekit-portal-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/generated ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/livekit_portal_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/generated dist/
